# Crunch Carbon - Complete Guide

> Turn solar energy into verified carbon credits and cash in South Africa.

## Company Overview

Crunch Carbon is a South African platform that helps solar panel owners monetize their clean energy generation through verified carbon credits. We bridge the gap between individual solar installations and international carbon markets, making it simple for anyone with solar panels to earn additional income.

## What We Do

We convert the environmental benefit of solar energy generation into tradeable carbon credits. Every kilowatt-hour of solar energy displaces grid electricity (which in South Africa is largely coal-generated), creating a measurable carbon emission reduction. We aggregate these reductions, verify them to international standards, and sell them on carbon markets - sharing the proceeds with system owners.

---

## For Homeowners

### Earning Potential

- **Typical 5kWp system**: R600-R1,000+ per year
- **Larger systems**: Proportionally higher earnings
- **10kWp system**: R1,200-R2,000+ per year
- **Commercial systems**: Significantly higher returns

### How Earnings Are Calculated

Earnings depend on:
1. System size (kWp)
2. Actual energy generation (kWh)
3. Carbon credit market prices
4. Grid emission factor

### Process for Homeowners

1. **Sign up online** (5 minutes)
2. **Connect your inverter data** (we support all major brands)
3. **Verify your installation** (we may request commissioning certificate)
4. **Automatic monitoring** begins
5. **Annual payout** after credits are verified and sold

### What You Need

- Solar PV system in South Africa
- Internet-connected inverter OR monitoring system
- Bank account for payouts
- Proof of system ownership

**URL**: https://crunchcarbon.com/home-owners
**Calculator**: https://crunchcarbon.com/calculator

## For Solar Installers & Agents

### Partner Benefits

- **Commission per referral**: Earn on every client who registers
- **Add value to installations**: Offer clients additional ROI
- **Professional proposals**: Generate branded proposals instantly
- **Client dashboard**: Track all referrals and earnings
- **Marketing support**: Co-branded materials available

### How Agent Partnerships Work

1. **Apply to become an agent**: https://crunchcarbon.com/agents
2. **Get approved** (usually within 48 hours)
3. **Access your dashboard** with proposal tools
4. **Refer clients** using your unique link or proposals
5. **Earn commissions** when clients register and verify

### Agent Eligibility

- Solar installation companies
- Energy consultants
- Property developers
- Financial advisors
- Anyone with access to solar system owners

**URL**: https://crunchcarbon.com/agents

## Technical Details

### Supported Inverter Brands

- SolarEdge
- Enphase
- Huawei (FusionSolar)
- Sungrow
- Growatt
- Goodwe
- Fronius
- SMA
- And many more

### Data Collection

We collect generation data (kWh produced) through:
- Direct API integration with inverter portals
- Delegated access to monitoring platforms
- Manual upload for systems without internet connectivity

### Verification Standard

We use the **Verra Verified Carbon Standard (VCS)**, the world's most widely used voluntary carbon credit certification. This ensures:
- Credits are real and verified
- No double-counting
- Transparent methodology
- International market acceptance

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### General Questions

**Q: Is this legitimate?**
A: Yes. We are registered in South Africa and work with Verra-certified carbon credit standards. Thousands of systems are already registered on our platform.

**Q: How much does it cost?**
A: Nothing. Registration and ongoing participation are completely free. We only take a share of the carbon credit revenue - you never pay anything upfront.

**Q: When do I get paid?**
A: Payouts are annual, typically in Q1 each year for the previous year's generation. This timing aligns with the carbon credit verification and issuance cycle.

**Q: Can I leave at any time?**
A: Yes, you can unregister your system at any time with no penalties.

### Technical Questions

**Q: What system size do I need?**
A: Any size qualifies. Larger systems earn more, but even small 3kWp residential systems can participate.

**Q: Do I need a specific inverter brand?**
A: We support all major inverter brands. If your system has any form of monitoring, we can likely integrate with it.

**Q: What if my system isn't connected to the internet?**
A: We can work with manual data submission in some cases. Contact us to discuss options.

**Q: Does this affect my solar savings?**
A: No. Carbon credits are an additional benefit on top of your electricity savings. You keep all your existing benefits.

### Financial Questions

**Q: How is the payout calculated?**
A: We take your verified generation data, apply the grid emission factor, calculate carbon credits generated, sell them at market rates, and distribute your share.

**Q: What percentage do I receive?**
A: Homeowners typically receive 60-70% of the carbon credit revenue. The remainder covers verification, administration, and platform costs.

**Q: How do I receive payment?**
A: Direct bank transfer (EFT) to your South African bank account.

**Q: Is this taxable income?**
A: Please consult with a tax professional. In general, income from carbon credits may be subject to income tax.
